info.title: Beauty on Wheels Partner BFF
info.description: Partner BFF client-facing contracts. Requests use the platform access-token authorizer; downstream domain calls use the platform internal bearer from SSM, never the user token. GET /partner/{vendorId}/manager/home is the approved vendor-home dashboard composition surface (operationId getVendorHome). The previous sections-based manager-home payload is replaced by the stable vendor/home/capacity/meta contract documented below.

get.description: Approved vendor-home BFF operation (operationId getVendorHome). Composes vendor context, booking home-summary (owners/admins only), and capacity widgets. Membership is resolved via Vendor operational-access; unrelated callers receive 403. When nextAction is not OPEN_VENDOR_DASHBOARD, home and capacity operational data are omitted. Optional capacity dependency failures return 200 with meta.partialData and unavailableSections. Core identity/home-summary failures return 4xx/5xx. No /vendors/{vendorId}/home alias is exposed; this /partner/{vendorId}/manager/home path is the stable public route.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Target vendor selector; membership is re-checked server-side and must match the caller's active vendor membership (or platform admin).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional civil date YYYY-MM-DD for the home summary; defaults to the vendor operations today.

parameters.name: upcomingDays
parameters.description: Upcoming day window for the home summary (1-7). Defaults to 3.

get.description: Returns a stable summary over the requested filter scope and a paginated list for the requested view. Changing view does not recalculate the summary.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Target vendor selector; membership is re-checked server-side and must match the caller's active owner vendor.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Service date in YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the vendor operations date.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor bound to the vendor, current filters, and the snapshot instant of the first page. A walk never repeats or skips a visit that stays on the date.
